profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Facebook and hobbyist programmer

company.name: Computer Science Department, USC Viterbi School of Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked on front-end web development in Javascript (React library) and CSS for Facebook Chat and Messenger.com.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Instructing children and teens age 7-17 about video game design, robotics, and C++ programming.

volunteerExperiences.description: I participated in many service projects and gained a great deal of leadership experience on my way to becoming an Eagle Scout.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Monrovia High School Marching Wildcats Band and Colorguard
volunteerExperiences.description: When I was a member of the band, I worked to help the Marching Wildcats fund-raise and put on events.  Since I graduated high school and left the program, I often return to help run large events.  I often take a leadership role like helping communicate with other schools and work out in-the-moment logistics of competitions and other events with many schools in attendance.
